questions.stem_text: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The bookshelf is in front of the bed.”
options: The bed is behind the bookshelf.
The bed is between two bookshelves.
The bed is next to the bookshelf.
The bookshelf is under the bed.
written_answers: The bed is behind the bookshelf.
questions.explanation_vi: In front of and behind are opposites.

questions.stem_text: Choose the correct sentence from: “Lan / not / play / computer games / at the moment.”
options: Lan doesn't plays computer games at the moment.
Lan isn't playing computer games at the moment.
Lan aren't playing computer games at the moment.
Lan not playing computer games at the moment.
written_answers: Lan isn't playing computer games at the moment.
questions.explanation_vi: At the moment + present continuous negative.
